base_url.correction: https://data.cityofchicago.org/resource is one city portal host, not the SODA platform base URL; SODA has no single global base — each domain is `{domain}/resource/{dataset-id}.{format}` (e.g. https://data.seattle.gov/resource/...). Prefer documenting the pattern or omitting a single base_url.

rate_limits.correction: With an app token: ~1,000 requests/hour per IP (soft throttle). Without a token: much lower (docs cite ~100 requests/hour or throttling without a token). Higher limits available via agreement with the portal. Not "not published".

notes: base_url wrongly uses one city host as the platform base. rate_limits are published (app-token throttling). Auth, docs, free access, example curl, and Tyler ownership check out.
